$description: Closed values the UI iterates over or waits on (declarations over code). `data_sources` are the server's sources (adapters/observer/server.py). Times are milliseconds: `poll_ms` how often the app asks whether the store changed; a failed answer is asked again after twice the wait, up to `backoff_cap_ms`; a run's sheet that failed is asked again after `retry_ms` doubling up to `backoff_cap_ms`, `retries` times, and always by the Retry button; `copied_ms` how long a copy button says Copied; `typed_ms` how long typing in the search waits before it asks. `tones` are the semantic colours a state may take (the contrast check judges each). `hosts` are the hosts whose names the copy knows (an unknown host is shown by the id it recorded). `periods` are the value strip's windows in days (null: all time). `page` is how many rows a page asks for, `group_cap` how many a group on the home shows before `Show all`, `needs_cap` the same for the needs-a-human group, `max_rows` the most row nodes the work list keeps, `overscan` the rows kept beyond the visible ones, `calendar_days` the days the calendar spans, `calendar_projects` the projects it lists. Value lists are not here: they are generated from the contract (enums.json). `periods` are the strip's windows (days, or `all`); `filters` the facets a list can be filtered by; `needs_standing` the standing whose runs wait on a human (the inbox's first group, the `g n` key). `switch` is the header's two sides, the Universe and the Inbox (each has copy `switch.*`). `statuses` are the ways the app can fail to show what it was asked for (each has copy `app.status.*`). `universe` is the Universe's geometry (app/geometry.js names each function that uses these). World units: the sunflower's constant `mark_c` (a mark's place k sits at mark_c·√(k+½) from its island's centre, so any two are ≥ 1.546·mark_c apart; the place is the observer's `marks.place`); an island is mark_c·√n plus `island_margin` across half, n its runs or its furthest place, at most `slot_places`, its slot's capacity (past it later places fall between the first ones on the same fixed lattice, `latticePlace`: none ever moves or rescales); every island sits in a slot of that maximum radius, the slots (each with its name's band, `label_world` tall) packed `island_gap` apart in the observer's project order, nearest the centre by an ellipse `pack_aspect` wide to 1 tall, trying `pack_angles` places around each. Screen: a mark is a dot `dot_share`·mark_c across half (at most `dot_max_px`) at store zoom and a shape `glyph_share`·mark_c (at most `glyph_max_px`) zoomed in; the store's camera fills the part no bar covers and an island's shows at most `island_scale_max` px a world unit, `fit_margin_px` inside the part no bar covers (`hud_top_px`, `hud_bottom_px`, the key's column, `key_w_px` plus `hud_pad_px` each side, while it is open, and the project card's, `card_w_px`, on an island; the key is `key_head_px` plus `key_row_px` a standing, the card `card_head_px` plus `key_row_px` a standing). An island's name is `label_char_px` a character (IBM Plex Mono's 0.6 em at text-3xs, 9 px; the line under it `label_sub_char_px`, 0.6 em at text-3xs, 9 px, the floor) plus `label_pad_px` wide and `label_px` tall (two lines), `label_gap_px` from its disc, at most `labels` named; at most `callouts` callouts of `callout_w` × `callout_px`, `callout_gap` apart, each with the shortest leader free (boxes tried `callout_step_px` apart, or a fortieth of the reach): at most `callout_reach` times its island's radius long, inside its own island at most `callout_slack` times the shortest way out, else not drawn (the +N more counts it). A pulse reaches `pulse_scale` times its mark, a caught dot `caught_share` of one, lines `stroke_px`, the keyboard's focus ring `focus_line_px` thick and `focus_px` out. An island's glow fades from `glow_inner` to `glow_outer` of its radius at `glow_alpha` of its hue (one of `island_hues`, tokens island-1…), its shore `shore_px` thick at `shore_alpha` dashed `shore_dash`. The journeys hold marks at least `min_dot_px` (store) and `min_glyph_px` (island) across. A run's zoom is its own scene: every other mark at `graph_dim`, the run `run_px` across half with its standing's word `word_px` tall under it, at most `claims_cap` claims, each a node `claim_px` across half (its link `claim_hit_px`, which no label covers) on rings at least `orbit_ring` px apart and `claim_gap_px` clear of each other, labelled with at most `claim_chars` characters at `claim_char_px` plus `claim_pad_px`, `claim_label_px` tall; its attempts a chain of glyphs `chain_px` across half, `chain_step_px` apart. The sheet draws the same graph small: rings `sheet_ring`, nodes `sheet_node_px`, the run `sheet_run_px`, labels `sheet_label_px` tall at `sheet_char_px` a character. An island's mirror lists at most `mirror_cap` marks (one page of the server's); a dimmed mark is `dim` opaque. Every counted loop in app/geometry.js stops after `loop_cap` steps whatever its input.
